name: secret-engine
author: Christian Paul (https://github.com/cpauldev)
description: SecretEngine is a context-bound encryption and secret utility toolkit for TypeScript applications that need to store API keys, tokens, verification codes, and other sensitive values safely.

scripts.test:smoke: bun -e "const mod = await import('./dist/index.js'); for (const key of ['SecretEngine','encryptWithKey','decryptWithKey','deriveKeyHKDF','maskSecret','generateCode','hashSecret','verifySecretHash']) { if (typeof mod[key] !== 'function') throw new Error('Missing export: ' + key); }"
